Non-sensitive liveness and protected readiness on the online service; simulated database/storage outage shows unhealthy without leaking details
Structured logs and metrics for uploads, emails, check-ins and fleet actions reach the approved sink without player emails or keys
Fleet records, registrations, sent items and blocked-address hashes survive a service restart and redeploy
Schema migrations apply forward on a copy of the previous release's data and the previous release keeps working until cut-over (or a documented rollback path exists)
PostgreSQL 18 backups are enabled at the target and an off-provider dump to R2 is produced
